name: @simcity/desktop
description: SimCity desktop shell: Electron over the Vite build of packages/app
author: SimCity

scripts.build:main: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=esm --external electron --outfile out/main.js && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile out/preload.cjs
scripts.build: bun run electron:install && bun run build:main && bun run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.build:obfuscated: bun run electron:install && bun run build:main && bun run build:renderer:obfuscated && electron-builder --mac --arm64
